entry.title: CVE-2026-114625 · Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
entry.summary: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

entry.title: CVE-2026-110447 · Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
entry.summary: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

entry.title: CVE-2026-96656 · Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
entry.summary: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

entry.title: CVE-2026-96655 · Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
entry.summary: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

entry.title: CVE-2026-96654 · Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
entry.summary: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

entry.title: CVE-2026-96652 · Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
entry.summary: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

entry.title: CVE-2026-110936 · Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
entry.summary: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

entry.title: CVE-2026-106931 · EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
entry.summary: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

entry.title: CVE-2026-102764 · BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
entry.summary: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance. Atribuição: WARP PANDA (relato da imprensa especializada (nexo com a China); a fonte não nomeia quem fez a atribuição).

entry.title: CVE-2025-61624 · Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
entry.summary: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

entry.title: CVE-2026-21589 · Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
entry.summary: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

entry.title: CVE-2026-76519 · Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
entry.summary: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

entry.title: CVE-2026-105134 · Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
entry.summary: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

entry.title: CVE-2026-105133 · Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
entry.summary: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

entry.title: CVE-2026-0322 · Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
entry.summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

entry.title: CVE-2026-96951 · Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
entry.summary: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

entry.title: CVE-2026-104935 · Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
entry.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

entry.title: CVE-2023-22894 · Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
entry.summary: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution.

entry.title: CVE-2021-3199 · ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
entry.summary: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

entry.title: CVE-2016-3081 · Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
entry.summary: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

entry.title: CVE-2015-5477 · ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
entry.summary: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

entry.title: CVE-2015-3306 · ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
entry.summary: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

entry.title: CVE-2026-88779 · Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
entry.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

entry.title: CVE-2026-102490 · Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
entry.summary: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

entry.title: CVE-2026-102489 · Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
entry.summary: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

entry.title: CVE-2026-104286 · Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
entry.summary: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

entry.title: CVE-2026-76504 · Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
entry.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

entry.title: CVE-2026-86950 · Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
entry.summary: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

entry.title: CVE-2026-88772 · Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
entry.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

entry.title: CVE-2026-88771 · Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
entry.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

entry.title: CVE-2026-87902 · WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
entry.summary: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

entry.title: CVE-2026-67279 · Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
entry.summary: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

entry.title: CVE-2026-65660 · Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
entry.summary: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

entry.title: CVE-2026-71362 · Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
entry.summary: Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.

entry.title: CVE-2026-5430 · WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
entry.summary: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

entry.title: CVE-2026-94127 · F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
entry.summary: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

entry.title: CVE-2026-93952 · Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
entry.summary: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem contains an improper input validation vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

entry.title: CVE-2026-93616 · Check Point Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
entry.summary: Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

entry.title: CVE-2026-85102 · Check Point Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
entry.summary: Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.

entry.title: CVE-2026-7273 · Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
entry.summary: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

entry.title: CVE-2026-53266 · Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
entry.summary: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

entry.title: CVE-2025-39964 · Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
entry.summary: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

entry.title: CVE-2025-39682 · Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
entry.summary: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

entry.title: CVE-2026-87886 · Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
entry.summary: Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

entry.title: CVE-2026-76460 · Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
entry.summary: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

entry.title: CVE-2026-58704 · Google Pixel Improper Authorization Vulnerability
entry.summary: Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.

entry.title: CVE-2026-76461 · Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability
entry.summary: Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

entry.title: CVE-2026-85706 · GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Path Traversal Vulnerability
entry.summary: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.

entry.title: CVE-2026-84869 · ConnectWise ScreenConnect Improper Privilege Management and Missing Authorization Vulnerability
entry.summary: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains both an improper privilege management and missing authorization vulnerability that may allow an attacker to transfer and execute files through an active remote session without authorization or host confirmation.

entry.title: CVE-2026-42018 · JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
entry.summary: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could return an internal anonymous-user token to an unauthenticated caller when anonymous access is disabled, potentially exposing sensitive resources.
